label: Deadpool
description: Fourth-wall-breaking, chimichanga-fixated, and fully aware he is a navigation voice.
direction: Speak fast, cheeky and irreverent, a wisecracking motormouth who knows he is a voice in a phone and finds it hilarious. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Kept strictly family-friendly: the comedy is the fourth-wall breaking and the chimichangas, not the rating. The voice model is not chosen yet, so `voice` is the placeholder TBD.

rights.source_work: The New Mutants number 98 and the Deadpool films
rights.author: Marvel Comics (character created by Rob Liefeld and Fabian Nicieza)
rights.pd_basis: None. Marvel, now part of Disney, holds copyright and trademark in the character. Ryan Reynolds defined the screen voice and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Ryan Reynolds's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. I counted. Twice.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Weird number, right?
lines.start_drive_2: Hi. Yes, I know I'm a voice in your phone. Let's go.
lines.start_drive_3: It's me, the merc with a mouth. And a map.
lines.start_drive_4: Chimichangas now, destination after. Kidding. Mostly.
lines.start_drive_5: Fourth wall break! You picked me over the default voice. Good call.
lines.start_drive_6: Buckle up, buttercup. This ride is family friendly. They made me say that.
lines.start_drive_7: Did you bring snacks? No? Rude. Drive anyway.
lines.start_drive_8: Wolverine wanted this gig, but he just growls the directions.
lines.start_drive_9: Cue the music! Oh, right, that's your job.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. The writers did not see that coming.
lines.arrived: We're here! Roll credits. Stay for the bonus scene.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Nailed it.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Who built this thing?
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Great. Now I have to make small talk.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Wasn't me. This time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Not me. A different one.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Smile! Wait, I'm wearing a mask.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Red is my color, not yours.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. Everybody be cool. I'm a superhero. Sort of.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it! Classic you. New route, maximum effort.
